name: Soundcore
author: Biraj
description: Battery, ANC modes and sound effects for Soundcore earbuds in the Omarchy bar, via the OpenSCQ30 CLI.

barWidget.description: Per-pod and case battery, ambient sound mode (Noise Cancelling / Transparency / Normal) with per-mode settings, and Sound Effects.

schema.label: Bluetooth MAC address
schema.description: Pair the earbuds over Bluetooth first, then register them with `openscq30 paired-devices add -a <mac> -m <model>` and paste the same MAC address here, e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

schema.label: OpenSCQ30 model id
schema.description: SoundcoreD1202C = Soundcore R60i NC, SoundcoreD1202 = P31i (see `openscq30 list-models`). Only needed for `paired-devices add`; the widget itself does not send this.

schema.label: Path to the openscq30 CLI
schema.description: Leave empty to find `openscq30` on PATH.

schema.label: Hide the icon when the earbuds are unreachable
Desktop notifications
schema.description: Notify when the earbuds disconnect or a bud/case battery drops to 20% or below.
